farther and farther back, my strength disappearing along with the waters. Clever masters they were, masters whose bold servants dug ditches and damned high the waters, only to rule themselves where the water once ruled. Look there, meadow after green meadow, gardens, villages, forests. But come eat something now. The sun will soon be down. Out there! You see? Sails making for home tonight! Like birds, they know where safety lies. The harbor’s over there now. Ah, it’s so far off, a thin blue strip on the horizon— the sea. Right and left, as far as you can look, all this new land is thickly populated.

@@U04408@@
(The THREE at table in the garden.)

@@U04410@@
Why so silent? And nothing to quench your thirst?

@@U04412@@
I think he wants to hear about the miracle. You like talking. You tell him.

@@U04414@@
Yes! Well! And it was a miracle, too!
translation:
@@U04407@@
越来越远，我的力量随着海水消失了。他们是聪明的主人，主人的勇敢的仆人们挖沟渠，把水淹没，只是为了在水曾经统治的地方统治自己。看那儿，一片片绿色的草地、花园、村庄、森林。但现在来吃点东西吧。太阳很快就会落山。在那里！你看？今晚扬帆回家！像鸟一样，他们知道安全在哪里。港口现在就在那里。啊，距离太远了，地平线上有一条蓝色的细带——大海。左右两侧，放眼望去，这片新土地都人口稠密。

@@U04408@@
（三个人在花园里的餐桌旁。）

@@U04410@@
为什么这么沉默？又没有什么可以解渴的吗？

@@U04412@@
我想他想听听这个奇迹。你喜欢说话。你告诉他。

@@U04414@@
是的！出色地！这也是一个奇迹！
